_warning: GENERATED FILE - DO NOT EDIT. Built from the CSV by scripts/build-data.mjs; edits are lost on the next build. Edit the CSV, then run: npm run data:build

slug.note: The key everything else joins on. MUST be lowercase: SQLite string comparison is case-sensitive. Also the filename used by the per-manufacturer component files in data/seeds/<type>/.

kinds.note: SEMICOLON-DELIMITED LIST - this is a many-to-many relationship flattened into one cell, and the loader splits it into the manufacturer_kinds table. Permitted: ammo, bullet, powder, primer, brass, shotshell, retailer, reloading_equipment, wads. A maker that is both an ammo maker and a brass maker is ONE row with several kinds, not two companies. RESOLVED 2026-10-01: six powder brands (accurate, alliant, hodgdon, imr, ramshot, vihtavuori) were referenced by the powder CSVs but missing here, orphaning 98 of 169 powder rows. All six now exist and cross-dataset references resolve.

website.note: Maker's site. Required - a company with no site is not useful to a user looking for a source.

country.note: Country of manufacture, not of the brand owner.

region.note: Coarse region, used to group the directory in the UI.

status.note: All 36 rows are currently `active`. Several brands are owned by larger groups (Hodgdon owns IMR, Winchester, Accurate and Ramshot; Vista Outdoor owns Hornady, Federal and Remington), but that is recorded in `notes` - `acquired` is for a brand that no longer trades under its own name.

notes.note: Free prose, deliberately well-researched: brand ownership, product lines, and the reason a brand is or is not in scope. This is real editorial value, not filler, and it is the part most likely to go stale.

source_url.note: Where the company details were confirmed.
